tool_input.command:
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/base_url}}v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}' -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$token = [string](($login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop).accessToken)
$uri = '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/base_url}}v1/cs/configs?dataId=zhishu-file-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=suzhou-taicang-wuguan&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
'FILE_CONFIG_HTTP=' + [int]$response.StatusCode
$text = [string]$response.Content
'FILE_CONFIG_LENGTH=' + $text.Length
$jdbc = [regex]::Matches($text, '(?im)^\s*[^#\r\n]*(jdbc:|jdbcUrl)[^\r\n]+')
foreach ($match in $jdbc) { 'FILE_JDBC=' + (($match.Value -replace '(?i)(password|pwd)=([^;&,\s]+)','$1=[redacted]') -replace '(:[^:/@\s]+)@','$1@[redacted]') }
'DATASOURCE_LABELS=' + (([regex]::Matches($text, '(?m)^\s{8}([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*)\s*:') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }) -join ',')
